text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp begins. I hope to use this opportunity
to get Nishino Flower to open up to me, but—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my very best to grow as much as I can during this camp!
Um, but of course, I can always practice on my own, so please don't worry...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I have to make sure I don't cause trouble for Trainer...
I can't be a handful!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her desperate desire not to burden me hangs thick in the air.
Right from the start, there's a subtle sense of distance between us...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*... Just one more time... please...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's running lacked its usual rhythm. Weighed down by the
desperate urge to do her best, she seemed to just be spinning her wheels...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want her summer camp to be meaningful and fulfilling.
—What can I possibly do for her?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Telling her "Don't push yourself" or "Just have fun"
might end up cornering her even more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I need to approach her with the same genuine kindness she's always shown me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An idea strikes me from the time I've spent with Nishino Flower.
I don't know if it will work, but I'll pour my heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (In the end, I couldn't run the way I wanted to at all...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Hello? Dad, Mom? Is everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
『Sorry to bother you during camp.
We hadn't heard from you lately, so we got a little worried...』

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
『Knowing you, sweetie, even if something was wrong,
you probably wouldn't bring it up on your own.』

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-Um, you see... Well...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And so... even though I try so hard not to bother Trainer...
nothing I do goes right at all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I just don't want Trainer's time
to be wasted because of me...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text: 『...Hehe.』

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Mom?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text: 『Oh, Flower, you sound just like we used to back then, you know?』

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
『Why don't you try being more honest about how you feel?
I'm sure your Trainer wants that, too.』

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
『Worrying that you might be a burden... it's scary, isn't it?
But sharing your true feelings isn't imposing on anyone.』

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
『After all, it's how people come to understand each other.
Letting others know who you are is so very important.』

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Understand... each other...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
『It takes courage, but you can do it, Flower. Because
your mother and I found our courage from you, too.』

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Do you really think I can tell them...?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
『Didn't your Trainer give you
that very same courage, Flower?』

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm... so... s-sorry... For being like this...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (The words Trainer gave me when I was crying.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: 『I want to scout you.』

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (The words that gave me the strength to stand tall.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: 『You gave me courage.』

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Those words gave me—courage, too.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much, Mom, Dad!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Whew... haah!
Thank you for working so hard with me, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Great work! Let's keep it up this afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Trainer!!
Before we go grab lunch... p-please listen!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I... I've been worrying the whole time.
Thinking about how much trouble I caused you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... you had plans to go get lunch with the senior trainers, right?
And yet, I went and handed you that bento box...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You were just being kind and telling me how good it was,
and I... I got so happy that I jumped to conclusions... completely on my own...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explain that they only invited me after I had already finished eating,
and tell her from the bottom of my heart how truly happy her bento made me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that what happened? ...Then, I went and jumped to
conclusions again... That's so embarrassing...!
choice_data_list: Actually, to tell you the truth—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pull a bento box out of an insulated cooler bag.
It's a token of gratitude for Nishino Flower that I'd been waiting to give her.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A bento box...? F-For me?
Did you make this for me, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: It might not be the tastiest, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so happy! So... so very happy...!
choice_data_list: Now that happy feeling isn't one-sided anymore.
Now that happy feeling isn't one-sided anymore.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... ehehe. You're right! Both the bento you made for me,
and the one I made for you... are filled to the brim with love and care.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We sit together and eat our bentos, gazing out at the sea. Nishino Flower
gazes fondly at the tamagoyaki that got just a little bit burnt.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'd love... to trade bentos again.
I'll make sure to pack plenty of all your favorite foods.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer... will you pack
lots of my favorites next time, too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We spent a delightful lunchtime chatting about Nishino Flower's
favorites, her dislikes, and the new things she wanted to try.
